title: My running app's pull requests write their own posts
desc: I shipped Pheidi every day and told nobody. Merge & Tell turns each merge into a drafted post. Then a Pheidi PR where three cards disagreed rebuilt Merge & Tell's own PR page.

title: Screenshots that fail the build when they lie
desc: Pheidi's docs, Play Store listing, and promo video all come out of CI through Screenery. A test reads the source as a syntax tree so a stale screenshot can't sneak through.

title: Three robot sweeps drifted, so I built a factory
desc: Hand-written nightly sweeps turned into three different pipelines in two months. One wrote 24 KB of the same findings every night. NightForge is the one pipeline they all share now.
